_about: Every test, paper arm, live change or dated job that must be READ and REPORTED to the operator when it finishes. Standing rule (CLAUDE.md 'Reads due'): at the start of every session and at every status check run `python research/readsdue.py`; anything due or overdue is reported to the operator UNPROMPTED, with its bar and verdict; then mark it done here (status 'read' + 'read_note') in the same commit. Every new paper arm, live change with a watch item, or time-boxed test gets an entry HERE when it is started. Times are UTC.

items.what: One-bet-per-coin leak: after a small first fill, a top-up is sized as a whole bet (take_n capped by SIZE, not SIZE minus held), so a coin can hold 1.2-1.6 bets (SOL 09-19 174 vs 107; BTC 09-26 113 vs 97; BNB 09-25 115 vs 88; all won). Fix: under --one-full-bet cap a same-market re-buy at SIZE - held, except the late add. Deliberately NOT shipped on 09-28 (six changes in one night was a cause of 09-19).
